head.title: Marijuana Legalization Could Be On The Horizon For British Virgin Islands

og.title: Marijuana Legalization Could Be On The Horizon For British Virgin Islands
og.description: The British Virgin Islands (BVI) could soon have a bill to legalize marijuana before the legislature, according to a government official. Read more about this story here: https://www.marijuanamoment.net/marijuana-legalization-could-be-on-the-horizon-for-british-virgin-islands/
